properties.title: Modern Mission District Residence
properties.address: 123 Mission St, Unit 4B, San Francisco, CA 94103
properties.description: Experience modern luxury in the heart of the Mission District. This stunning 2-bedroom residence features an open-concept living area bathed in natural light, boasting floor-to-ceiling windows with panoramic city views. The chef's kitchen is equipped with top-of-the-line Viking appliances, custom cabinetry, and a spacious quartz island perfect for entertaining. The primary suite offers a serene retreat with a spa-like ensuite bath featuring a soaking tub and rainfall shower.

properties.title: Luxury Pacific Heights Penthouse
properties.address: 789 Pacific Ave, Penthouse A, San Francisco, CA 94133
properties.description: Spectacular penthouse living awaits in this architectural masterpiece. Soaring 12-foot ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows, and two private terraces offer breathtaking views of the Golden Gate Bridge and Bay. The gourmet kitchen features premium Miele appliances, Italian marble countertops, and custom millwork throughout.

properties.title: Charming Victorian in Noe Valley
properties.description: Meticulously restored Victorian gem in the heart of Noe Valley. This classic beauty combines original period details with modern amenities. High ceilings, original hardwood floors, and ornate crown molding throughout. Updated kitchen and baths while preserving the home's historic charm.

properties.title: Industrial Loft in SoMa
properties.address: 222 Brannan St, Unit 501, San Francisco, CA 94107
properties.description: True loft living in a converted warehouse. This 5th-floor unit features original brick walls, exposed timber beams, and dramatic concrete floors. The open-plan layout is perfect for artists or professionals seeking a creative space.

properties.title: Waterfront Condo at Lumina
properties.description: Luxurious high-rise living at Lumina. This waterfront-facing unit offers world-class amenities and unparalleled finishes. Enjoy access to a residents' lounge, rooftop terrace with BBQ area, and a state-of-the-art fitness center.

properties.title: Classic Haight-Ashbury Flat
properties.description: Charming Edwardian flat with original architectural details. Rent this piece of San Francisco history featuring high ceilings, pocket doors, and a decorative fireplace. Just steps from the Panhandle and Golden Gate Park.

properties.title: Modernist View Home in Twin Peaks
properties.description: Perched on Twin Peaks, this modernist masterpiece offers 270-degree views of the City, Bay, and Ocean. Multi-level living with floor-to-ceiling glass, a dedicated media room, and a wrap-around deck.

properties.title: Renovated Marina District Condo
properties.description: Exquisite Marina District condo steps from the Palace of Fine Arts. Recently renovated with top-tier finishes while maintaining Art Deco charm. Sprawling floor plan with a chef's kitchen and shared rooftop deck with Golden Gate views.

properties.title: Cozy Studio in North Beach
properties.description: Live like a local in North Beach. This cozy studio is centrally located near the city's best cafes, restaurants, and jazz bars. Perfect for those who value location above all else.

properties.title: Skyline View Loft in Dogpatch
properties.description: Stunning top-floor loft in the trendy Dogpatch neighborhood. Massive double-height windows provide incredible city skyline views. Modern kitchen with gas range and a spacious mezza-nine level bedroom.

properties.title: Family Home in Sunset District
properties.description: Spacious and bright family home in the desirable Outer Sunset. Features a large backyard, updated kitchen, and a finished basement perfect for a home office or play area. Close to Ocean Beach and Golden Gate Park.

properties.title: Luxury Condo in Russian Hill
properties.address: 999 Lombard St, Unit 3A, San Francisco, CA 94133
properties.description: Sophisticated condo living on iconic Lombard Street. Enjoy stunning Bay and Alcatraz views from your private balcony. Features include a chef's kitchen, spa-like baths, and access to a shared rooftop terrace.

properties.title: Contemporary Home in Bernal Heights
properties.description: Modern living in vibrant Bernal Heights. This home boasts an open floor plan, high-end finishes, and a walk-out deck with city views. Enjoy easy access to local shops, parks, and restaurants.

properties.title: Historic Home in Presidio Heights
properties.description: Grand historic home in prestigious Presidio Heights. This elegant residence features formal living and dining rooms, a renovated chef's kitchen, and a lush private garden. Steps from the Presidio National Park.
